prompt: A pump fills a tank at $4$ gallons per minute. How long to fill a $100$-gallon tank?
hint: Divide total gallons by the rate.

hints.title: 🪜 Try a simpler one
hints.text: Try the same problem with friendlier numbers first — say "20% of 50" — then come back to this one.
Divide total gallons by the rate.
